verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents threshold-based alerts on Errors, Cost, and Feedback Score, with routing to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any webhook endpoint, so most of the story is covered. Email is not documented as a notification channel. Feedback Score is not explicitly tied to online-evaluator score drops, and there is no hands-on or independent corroboration. missing for 10: documented email notification channel, explicit evidence that alerts fire on online eval-score drops, independent/hands-on corroboration of alerting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set alerts on error rates, cost spikes, or eval-score drops and get notified in Slack, PagerDuty, or email

citations.quote: LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
Alerts can route to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or any HTTP endpoint via webhook.
for Errors and Latency, you can use the filter builder to stack conditions on fields such as Status, Run Type, Tag, and Error.
